text:
mia: Heads up — noticed weird chunk ordering and duplicated partial JSON in stream-fiddle when client reconnects after auth refresh. Repro steps below.

sam: ugh, that sounds like the resume logic is replaying fragments. Can you paste logs?

mia: repro: node-sdk v0.9.3, browser sdk 0.10.1. Steps:
1) start stream-fiddle with `--prompt "long gen"`
2) let it run ~30s so auth token expires
3) SDK refreshes token, client reconnects with `Last-Event-ID` set to previous resume token
4) got duplicate fragments and malformed JSON

mia: log excerpt:
```
[stream-fiddle] recv chunk: {"id":"tok_123","seq":45,"partial":"{\"text\": \"Hello\""
[stream-fiddle] reconnect w/ Last-Event-ID=tok_123
[stream-fiddle] recv chunk: \" world\"}\n
[parse] JSON.parse error: Unexpected token " in JSON at position 1
```

lee: that's the classic interleaving: reconnect caused server to send tail of previous fragment as new fragment start, parser sees broken framing. :facepalm: 

sam: is this Node-only? browser behaves differently due to EventSource auto-reconnect? parity bug maybe.

mia: Node only in our repro. Browser uses native EventSource which seems to drop the partial and resume fine. Node SDK's internal parser tries to reassemble but treats each 'message' event as atomic which is wrong when server sends interleaved chunks.

dev-rel: we should add sequence numbers in SSE payload to make client reassembly deterministic (seq, fragment_index). Also consider idempotent resume tokens.

sam: quick patch idea for node-sdk: keep a small rolling buffer and only attempt JSON.parse when buffer ends with newline+\n or when we see a closing brace with balanced braces. Less eager parse.

mia: also saw 401 mid-stream, SDK triggers reconnect + replay and server replays last fragment, creating duplicate tokens at parse layer. Probably our auth refresh retry policy should not reconnect mid-fragment.

lee: agree. Maybe delay reconnect until fragment boundary or set Accept-Range header so server can send explicit chunk boundaries? Would require server change.

dev-rel: creating issue: devex/stream-reconnect-frag-repro, adding repro script + logs. @sam can you take node-sdk fix? I'll attach sample logs and minimal script.

sam: I'll take it. Plan: add buffered-reassembly, fallback to strict newline framing, and add unit tests using injected partial chunk sequences. Will target patch for v0.9.4.

opsbot: CI: created issue #3421 and assigned to sam. :robot_face: 

mia: thanks — repro and temp workaround: set SDK option `streaming: { toleratePartial: true }` to avoid throwing and rejoin logic. Not ideal but unblocks devs.

lee: note for docs: warn about token refresh race when long-running streams may overlap refresh window. Add to streaming best-practices.

mia: filing PR with repro in stream-fiddle now.

sam: thanks, will prioritize.
